evidence.name: Screen field: Selected plan style
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Selected plan style" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Selected plan style
sections.description: How a plan card looks once it's the chosen one: background color, border, and spacing. Make it clearly stand out from the unselected cards, for example a brand-colored border or filled background, so the user is never unsure which plan they're about to buy. Crisp selected styling removes hesitation right before checkout.
